entries.purpose: Solve one leaf steady-state energy balance for each fixed-forcing simulation segment.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: F(T_leaf) = R_sw_abs + R_lw_net - H - LE; solve F(T_leaf)=0 with deterministic bisection.
entries.source_title: Leaf Temperature and Energy Fluxes; tealeaves leaf energy budget
entries.valid_domain: Single leaf, explicit radiation, supported vapor-pressure domain 0-50 degC, supported laminar boundary-layer regime.
assumptions: Steady state with physical heat storage S=0.
Fixed environmental and beginning-of-segment hydraulic forcing.
Projected one-sided leaf area basis.
notes: Not a growth, stress, yield, or survival model.

entries.purpose: Convert explicitly supplied incident shortwave energy to absorbed leaf shortwave energy.
entries.valid_domain: Explicit broadband incident energy; no hidden PPFD conversion.
assumptions: Single scalar broadband absorptance.
PAR/NIR split and canopy interception are excluded.
notes: PPFD and renderer lighting are separate state domains.

entries.purpose: Calculate net longwave exchange with explicitly configured radiative surroundings.
entries.source_title: tealeaves: an R package for modelling leaf temperature using energy budgets
entries.valid_domain: Kelvin-convertible temperatures; emissivity in (0,1]; explicit surroundings required.
assumptions: Broadband gray-body exchange.
Configured surface factor represents the selected leaf area convention.
notes: Air temperature is never silently substituted for radiative surroundings.

entries.purpose: Use the accepted boundary-layer flow regime and heat-transfer conductance for sensible heat exchange.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: H = surface_factor * g_bh * rho_air * cp_air * (T_leaf - T_air); g_bh = thermal_diffusivity * Nu / d using shared mixed-convection regime.
entries.valid_domain: Existing supported boundary-layer regime, including Re <= 20000 policy and positive characteristic dimension.
assumptions: Flat-plate boundary layer.
Shared vapor and heat aerodynamic state.
Air property approximation is deterministic and pressure/temperature dependent.
entries.approximation_status: mechanistic mixed-convection approximation with explicit domain guard
notes: Unsupported flow invalidates coupled leaf-energy outputs even when gas exchange converges.

entries.purpose: Convert the authoritative P1B.4.1 transpiration molar flux into latent heat flux.
entries.source_title: FAO-56 Annex 3: Background on physical parameters used in evapotranspiration computations
entries.valid_domain: 0 <= T_leaf_C <= 50; latent flux from available P1B.4.1 result only.
assumptions: Water molar mass 0.01801528 kg mol^-1.
Leaf temperature is the reference temperature.
Negative condensation LE is allowed but never becomes negative plant withdrawal.
notes: Unavailable transpiration is not represented as zero latent heat.

entries.purpose: Provide deterministic bounded scalar root solving for leaf temperature.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: Intersect [-40,100] degC with [T_air-80,T_air+80] degC and the supported vapor-pressure domain; require endpoint sign change, then bisect until width <= 0.001 K and abs(F) <= 0.01 W m^-2.
entries.valid_domain: Finite residuals with a sign-changing bracket; maximum 32 iterations.
assumptions: Numerical bounds are not biological limits.
No wall clock or random state enters the solve.
No bracket, non-finite residual, unavailable input, and iteration exhaustion are explicit failures.
notes: Pure trial evaluations do not mutate root-zone state.

entries.source_title: CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants
assumptions: Temperature is converted to Kelvin before use.

entries.purpose: Physical water molar mass used to convert FAO latent heat per mass to per mole.
authors: IUPAC Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic Weights
entries.valid_domain: Physical constant for ordinary water molecular mass conversion.
assumptions: The conversion does not model isotopic composition of water.

entries.purpose: Deterministic air density, heat capacity, Prandtl number, and thermal diffusivity policy for leaf sensible heat.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: rho = P/(R_specific*T_K); cp = 1005 J kg^-1 K^-1; alpha = nu/Pr with Pr=0.71.
entries.valid_domain: Positive absolute temperature and pressure in the existing air-property domain.
assumptions: Dry-air ideal-gas density policy; humidity correction is not separately modeled in P1B.5.
Constant cp and Pr are engineering approximations.
notes: No gameplay tuning constant is embedded in this policy.
